D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ GLORI A EXER CITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), possibly Trier mint, Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17; possibly issue of 330-331; if so, RIC vol. 7 page 214 no. 520. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate cuirassed right, large eye, seen from front. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse…
